vulnerabilities.description: MIT Kerberos 5 (krb5) through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference in make_cred_list() in rd_cred.c that allows authenticated Kerberos clients to crash services by sending mismatched KRB-CRED arrays. Attackers can send forwarded credentials with more tickets than ticket_info entries through gss_accept_sec_context() to crash GSS-API acceptor services, causing denial of service.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. The image runs no GSS-API acceptor service, and Liquibase uses the Java runtime's own Kerberos implementation.

ratings.justification: CNA score; NVD had not yet published its own score at assessment time.
The flaw is only reachable in a GSS-API acceptor service; the image runs none and Liquibase never loads MIT Kerberos.

analysis.detail: The NULL pointer dereference in krb5_rd_cred() is reached through gss_accept_sec_context(), so it only affects GSS-API acceptor (server) services. The liquibase/liquibase-secure 6.0.3 image runs no Kerberos or GSS-API acceptor service. No native library of the bundled Java runtime links the MIT Kerberos libraries, and Liquibase uses the JVM's own pure-Java Kerberos implementation. The libraries are loaded only by curl and libssh, which Liquibase does not run; the image entrypoint runs Liquibase, and runs another program only when the user passes it as the container command.
